concept_options.title: It's oil, not a chakra
concept_options.hook: Stick this on your forehead. It stays. Not your third eye.
concept_options.visual_approach: Cream/brass/navy kinetic cards: bobby pin hero, crossed-out glue, eye+magnet X, mint oil drop, physicist card. Mute-first slam type. No faces.
concept_options.target_audience: TikTok/YouTube Shorts viewers who already saw the stitch and want the one-line why
key_points: A bobby pin (or paperclip, or fork) stays on the flat center of the forehead with no glue or tape.
The trick is not a magnetic third eye — brain EMF is far too weak to hold metal.
Dr Sara Webb (Swinburne astrophysicist) told news.com.au the hold is surface tension from sebum; the flatter center beats the temples.
concept_options.core_message: Your forehead is just sticky. Sebum plus surface tension, not a chakra.
concept_options.cta: Try it dead center, then stitch the science.
grounded_in: Khaleej Times Sep 2 2026 recap + Sara Webb quote
Times Now: brain EMF too weak; sebum + micro-texture + friction
concept_options.why_this_works: This week's stitchable experiment has a named physicist and a one-line bust. Works as stills plus slam captions. Distinct from last week's ghost-creators news short.

concept_options.title: A trailer you can fight
concept_options.hook: YouTube shipped a movie trailer you play like Street Fighter.
concept_options.visual_approach: Would need licensed World Warrior Tour / Playables footage of Hadoken inputs over the trailer.
key_points: Paramount/Legendary launched a YouTube Playables Combo Challenge with the Street Fighter trailer around Sep 1 2026.
Studios call it the first full-length movie trailer made playable through YouTube Playables.
Film lands Oct 16 2026; World Warrior Tour Tokyo was Sep 1–2.
concept_options.core_message: The trailer is now a combo trial.
concept_options.cta: Open the Playables challenge before Oct 16.
concept_options.why_this_works: Real same-week YouTube product news, but this machine cannot use licensed trailer footage and unverified view counts stay out.

concept_options.title: Say gnocchi
concept_options.hook: TikTok is grading boyfriends on gnocchi and epitome.
concept_options.visual_approach: Caption cards of SAT-hard words over dating-discourse clips we do not have rights to restage.
key_points: News Dive Sep 3 recapped the Illiterate Boyfriend pronunciation challenge.
Couples test words like gnocchi, epitome, fuchsia; one clip was cited at 8.8M views.
concept_options.core_message: Pronunciation is the new compatibility test.
concept_options.cta: Don't film your partner without consent.
grounded_in: News Dive Sep 3 Illiterate Boyfriend recap
concept_options.why_this_works: Viral this week, but the format is gender-war bait and we will not produce it.
